create_A11yGrpcWrapper: create an A11yGrpcWrapper instance wrapping an AndroidEnv to receive accessibility events over gRPC
build_A11yGrpcWrapper_with_install: build an A11yGrpcWrapper that auto-installs the accessibility forwarder APK and starts the service
reset_A11yGrpcWrapper: reset the A11yGrpcWrapper environment and reconfigure gRPC if the AVD was relaunched
step_A11yGrpcWrapper: step the A11yGrpcWrapper environment with an action and optional wait time for a11y info
task_extras_A11yGrpcWrapper: retrieve accumulated accessibility task extras from the wrapper with optional latest-only filtering
